text_block_list.text:
Jun ▽, Post-Race | Wind: Sudden Headwind 
"Sea Route to Treasure Island" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Hooray!! We took down the reigning 
strongest, Kris S, and conquered the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With the Kinko Sho and today's victory 
under our belt, we're finally ready to 
take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Our 
course is completely clear!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
After returning to Japan, her next goal 
was set on the Japan Cup— the very race 
that sparked her admiration for Ace— and 
her excitement reached its absolute peak, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Navigator, what do you mean by 'leave our 
crew behind'!? What's gonna happen to our 
dream!?
